english: The student is going to school.
The student is reading a book.
The school is in the town.
The children come to school on time.
The school opened in the morning.
The book is on the table.
The students are in the classroom.
The teacher is in the classroom.
The teacher wrote on the board.

igbo: Nwa akwụkwọ ahụ na-eji pensụl ede ihe.
english: The student uses a pencil to write.

igbo: Nwa akwụkwọ ahụ zara ajụjụ ahụ.

english: The students are learning new things.

igbo: Ndị nne na nna na-akwado agụmakwụkwọ.
Onye nkuzi na-enyere ụmụ akwụkwọ aka.
Ụmụ akwụkwọ ghọtara ihe ọmụmụ ahụ.
Nwa akwụkwọ ahụ aghọtaghị ajụjụ ahụ.
english: The student did not understand the question.
The students study the Igbo language.

igbo: Akụkọ ihe mere eme bụ isiokwu dị mkpa.
Nwa akwụkwọ ahụ hụrụ sayensị n'anya.
Ịgụ akwụkwọ na-eme ka mmadụ mara ihe.
Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-agụ akwụkwọ n'ọbá akwụkwọ.
english: The students read books in the library.

igbo: Ọbá akwụkwọ ahụ nwere ọtụtụ akwụkwọ.
Onye nkuzi nyere ha ọrụ ụlọ.
Nwa akwụkwọ ahụ na-akwadebe maka ule.
english: The student is preparing for an examination.

igbo: Nwa akwụkwọ ahụ gafere ule ahụ.
Nwa akwụkwọ ahụ dara ule ahụ.
Ịgụ akwụkwọ na-enyere ụmụ akwụkwọ aka.
Ụmụ akwụkwọ gere onye nkuzi ntị.
english: The students listened to the teacher.

igbo: Ọ dị mkpa ige ntị na klaasị.
english: It is important to listen in class.

igbo: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ahụ nwere ọtụtụ klaasị.

english: The students are sitting on chairs.
The teacher stood in front of the classroom.

igbo: Ịrụkọ ọrụ ọnụ na-enyere ụmụ akwụkwọ aka.
Nwa akwụkwọ ahụ gosipụtara ọrụ ya.
Onye nkuzi nyochara ọrụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.
english: The teacher checked the students' work.

igbo: Nwa akwụkwọ ahụ nwetara akara dị elu.
english: The student got a high mark.
The students compete in their studies.

igbo: Ọrụ siri ike na-eweta ihe ịga nke ọma.

english: He wants to go to university.

igbo: Mahadum ahụ nwere ọtụtụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.
Nwa akwụkwọ ahụ na-amụ sayensị kọmputa.

english: He is studying for his examination.
The university lecturer taught the class.

igbo: Ịntanetị na-enyere ụmụ akwụkwọ aka ịmụ ihe.
Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-eji kọmputa amụ ihe.
Nwa akwụkwọ ahụ gara klasị n'ịntanetị.
english: The student attended an online class.

igbo: Onye nkuzi zitere ihe ọmụmụ n'ịntanetị.
english: The teacher sent learning materials online.

igbo: Ọ dị mkpa ịmụ ihe kwa ụbọchị.
english: It is important to study every day.
Education opens the way to the future.

igbo: Nwa akwụkwọ ahụ nwere nnukwu nrọ.
english: The student has a big dream.
He wants to become a teacher.

igbo: Ọmụmụ ihe na-enyere mmadụ aka iru ihe mgbaru ọsọ ya.
english: Learning helps a person achieve their goals.

igbo: Ụmụ akwụkwọ kwesịrị ịrụsi ọrụ ike.
Agụmakwụkwọ bụ isi ihe na mmepe obodo.
english: Education is essential for community development.
